correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the Fréchet linearization at a curvature -1 hyperbolic geodesic sphere: delta W=-Hess(u)-u(W^2-I), delta F=-(alpha/n)(coth R-1)^(alpha-1)(Delta u+n csch^2(R)u), and the area-average variation cancels measure terms because F is constant. Spherical harmonic eigenvalues yield degree-zero/degree-one neutral modes and strictly negative all higher-degree eigenvalues; degree two gives the sharp gap. Differentiating its q=e^(-2R) closed form and inserting hyperbolic ball asymptotics yields monotonicity and the exact V^(-2alpha/n) coefficient for every n>=2, alpha>0, R>0. No nonlinear all-initial-data convergence is inferred.
